mapping.draft_py:
# Slumbering Cerberus (FDN), a 4/2 Dog for {1}{R}.
# "This creature doesn't untap during your untap step.
#  Morbid — At the beginning of each end step, if a creature died this turn, untap this creature."
# [0] M21 Capture Sphere's verified "Enchanted creature doesn't untap during its controller's
#     untap step" (B5a-enchant-no-untap: a static PREVENT_EFFECT of TapStateEvent(tapped=False),
#     the untap-step consumer replacements.prevents_untap) with "this creature" in place of the
#     enchanted creature: condition and event filter IS_SOURCE. Only the untap step reads it, so
#     the morbid untap below still untaps (CR 502.3).
# [1] "At the beginning of each end step" has no actor (M21 Liliana's Scrounger's verified
#     B2a-lilianas-scrounger: TurnPhaseEvent END_TURN, the intervening "if" DIED_THIS_TURN as the
#     condition). "Untap this creature" is M21 Sabertooth Mauler's verified "untap it" on the
#     source. Morbid is an ability word (CR 207.2c).
no_untap = StaticAbility(
    effect=A(Verb.PREVENT_EFFECT, {
        'condition': FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
        'event': TapStateEvent(tapped=False, filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
    }),
)
morbid = TriggeredAbility(
    event=TurnPhaseEvent(phase=Phase.END_TURN),
    condition=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.DIED_THIS_TURN),
    effect=A(Verb.UNTAP, {
        'target': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
            filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        ),
    }),
)
abilities = [no_untap, morbid, *compiled]

clauses.clause: This creature doesn't untap during your untap step.
Morbid — At the beginning of each end step, if a creature died this turn, untap this creature.

mapping.notes: M21 Capture Sphere's untap-step prevention (verified) on the source (only the untap step reads it, so the morbid untap works); M21 Liliana's Scrounger's 'each end step' morbid trigger untapping the source (Sabertooth Mauler's UNTAP).
